payload.title: Greece Wedding Packages and What They Include
payload.excerpt: Two package documents from two Greek resorts can share a title and describe quite different weddings. Greece wedding packages usually bundle the ceremony, its set-up, a coordinator and some help with the paperwork.
key_takeaways: A Greek venue package usually covers the ceremony, its set-up and a coordinator, and the rest depends on the venue.
Civil, Greek Orthodox and symbolic ceremonies can be packaged separately, so check which one a package is built for.
Exclusive use, guest rooms, transfers and outside suppliers are where packages differ most, so ask about each in writing.
Compare quotes on the same guest count, spaces, hours, nights and currency before paying any deposit.

faq.q: Are Greek wedding packages all inclusive?
faq.a: Rarely in the sense most couples mean. Abaton's packages do not include accommodation, the Elounda Collection's exclude municipal or Metropolis fees, and Elounda Beach lists flowers for the location, photography and entertainment as additional services. Treat a package as the core of the day and ask for every extra in writing.

faq.q: Does a venue package include the legal paperwork?
faq.a: Some include help with it. Elounda Beach lists legal and licence paperwork requirements, and the Elounda Collection lists documentation assistance and settlement of the licence with the Municipality Office. The Elounda Collection states that symbolic weddings and vow renewals are not legally recognised under the Greek constitution. At the Elounda Collection, certifying, translating and couriering your documents still falls to you.

faq.q: Can we bring our own planner or suppliers?
faq.a: It depends on the venue. Grace Hotel requires a planner for every wedding, and Four Seasons Astir Palace works with your florist or consultant. Euphoria and Abaton sell complete packages whose items are not interchangeable. Neither publishes whether you may bring your own photographer or florist, so ask before you book.

faq.q: Do we have to book guest rooms to get a package?
faq.a: At some venues, yes. The Elounda Collection asks for a minimum three-night stay, and Abaton's terms set a minimum of 10 rooms for two nights. Grace Hotel sets no minimum number of rooms.

faq.q: Can Australians legally marry in Greece?
faq.a: Yes. Venues such as the Elounda Collection offer civil and Orthodox packages, and the marriage is then registered at the local Registry Office. A marriage made overseas is usually recognised in Australia if it was valid where it took place and would have been valid under Australian law, and a lawyer can confirm validity. Prepare documents well ahead. The Australian Embassy in Athens issues Certificates of No Impediment by appointment.
